data.description: One River Point – Urban Sophistication Meets Waterfront Serenity
data.display_address: One River Point, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Embrace the art of elevated living at One River Point, a striking development by Ellington along Dubai Canal in Business Bay. With stunning views of the Burj Khalifa and the Gulf, this tower offers a limited collection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments across 37 floors of residential space, built atop podium and basement levels.

Designed for an active yet relaxed lifestyle, residents enjoy premium amenities such as cycling paths, kids’ play zones, yoga areas, and more. The tower is secured round-the-clock and includes concierge services and dedicated parking. Proximity to retail, schools, and restaurants makes it ideal for families and professionals alike.
